scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names common,data,server,browser --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,yellow,green "pnpm --filter @app/common dev" "pnpm --filter @app/data dev" "pnpm --filter @app/server dev" "pnpm --filter @app/browser dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @app/common build && pnpm --filter @app/data build && pnpm --filter @app/api build && pnpm --filter @app/server build && pnpm --filter @app/browser build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @app/common build && pnpm --filter @app/data build && pnpm --filter @app/tests --fail-if-no-match typecheck && pnpm -r --filter !@app/tests typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @app/common build && pnpm --filter @app/data build && pnpm --filter @app/tests --fail-if-no-match test
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
